title: Delta customization
script:
--!strict
local CACHE_DIR = "DeltaCustomizationCache"
local CACHE_FILE = CACHE_DIR .. "/DeltaCustomizationModule.luau"
local REMOTE_URL = "https://gitlab.com/ltseverydayyou/uuuuuuu/-/raw/main/DeltaCustomizationModule.luau"
local CHUNK_NAME = "@DeltaCustomizationModule.luau"

local fs = {
	readFile = (type(readfile) == "function" and readfile) or nil,
	writeFile = (type(writefile) == "function" and writefile) or nil,
	isFile = (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile) or nil,
	isFolder = (type(isfolder) == "function" and isfolder) or nil,
	makeFolder = (type(makefolder) == "function" and makefolder) or nil,
}

local http_req = (type(request) == "function" and request)
	or (type(http_request) == "function" and http_request)
	or (type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" and syn.request)
	or nil

local function getExecutorName(): string
	if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
		local ok, name = pcall(identifyexecutor)
		if ok and type(name) == "string" then
			return name:lower()
		end
	end
	return "unknown"
end

local function ensureDirectory(): boolean
	if not fs.makeFolder then return false end
	if fs.isFolder then
		local ok, exists = pcall(fs.isFolder, CACHE_DIR)
		if ok and exists then return true end
	end
	return pcall(fs.makeFolder, CACHE_DIR)
end

local function loadFromDisk(): string?
	if not fs.readFile then return nil end
	if fs.isFile then
		local okExists, exists = pcall(fs.isFile, CACHE_FILE)
		if not (okExists and exists) then return nil end
	end

	local okRead, content = pcall(fs.readFile, CACHE_FILE)
	if okRead and type(content) == "string" and #content > 0 then
		return content
	end
	return nil
end

local function saveToDisk(content: string): boolean
	if not fs.writeFile then return false end
	ensureDirectory()
	return pcall(fs.writeFile, CACHE_FILE, content)
end

local function fetchRemoteSource(): (boolean, string?)
	if http_req then
		local ok, res = pcall(http_req, {
			Url = REMOTE_URL,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = {
				["User-Agent"] = "DeltaLoader/2.0",
				["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache",
			},
		})
		if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200 and type(res.Body) == "string" and #res.Body > 0 then
			return true, res.Body
		end
	end

	local okGet, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, REMOTE_URL)
	if okGet and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then
		return true, body
	end

	return false, nil
end

local function executePayload(source: string): (boolean, string?)
	local chunk, compileErr = loadstring(source, CHUNK_NAME)
	if not chunk then
		return false, "Compilation failed: " .. tostring(compileErr)
	end

	local success, runtimeErr = xpcall(chunk, debug.traceback)
	if not success then
		return false, "Runtime error: " .. tostring(runtimeErr)
	end

	return true, nil
end

local function checkAndUpdateCache(currentSource: string?)
	task.spawn(function()
		local fetchOk, remoteSource = fetchRemoteSource()
		if not (fetchOk and remoteSource) then return end

		if currentSource and remoteSource == currentSource then
			return
		end

		local testCompile, syntaxErr = loadstring(remoteSource, CHUNK_NAME)
		if not testCompile then
			warn("[DeltaLoader] Staged update dropped due to syntax error: " .. tostring(syntaxErr))
			return
		end

		if saveToDisk(remoteSource) then
			print("[DeltaLoader] Local cache successfully updated for next launch.")
		end
	end)
end

local function boot()
	local execName = getExecutorName()
	if not execName:find("delta") then
		warn("[DeltaLoader] Warning: Active executor is '" .. execName .. "'. Target module requires Delta.")
	end

	local cachedSource = loadFromDisk()

	if cachedSource then
		local ok, err = executePayload(cachedSource)
		if ok then
			checkAndUpdateCache(cachedSource)
			return
		else
			warn("[DeltaLoader] Cached payload failed to run. Falling back to fresh download: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end

	local fetchOk, remoteSource = fetchRemoteSource()
	assert(fetchOk and remoteSource, "[DeltaLoader] Fatal: Unable to retrieve remote script and no cache is present.")

	local ok, err = executePayload(remoteSource)
	if ok then
		saveToDisk(remoteSource)
	else
		error("[DeltaLoader] Fatal execution failure: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

boot()
